about: Country cards for lives born in Brazil. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Brazil (BR) ===================== FGTS: employers deposit 8% of pay; with saque-aniversário you withdraw part each year in your birthday month but, if fired without cause, only receive the 40% fine (Projuris; Banco Mercantil; O POVO, 2025). Yearly withdrawal size is an ESTIMATE.

set.do: fgts = { mode: m, since: age }; T('br_fgts', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_fgts') }); if (m === 'aniv') rec('br_fgts', -.04 * Math.max(salary(), base), 25); else later(60, 'fgts60', {})

later.fgts60: const f = fgts; if (!f || f.mode !== 'resc') return; const v = fgtsBal(); f.since = age; cash += v; const t = trk.br_fgts; if (t) { t.v += v; t.note = M('note.fgts', { a: MN(v) }); } log(M('log.fgts', { a: MN(v) }), 'good')

en..x: Your employer deposits 8% of your pay into an FGTS account. You can switch to saque-aniversário and take part of it out each year in your birthday month, but then, if you are fired without cause, you only get the 40% fine, not the whole balance.
en..resc.s: You get the whole balance and the fine if you’re fired, or at 60.
en..resc.h: A layoff comes with a bigger payout.
en..aniv.s: About {a} a year in your birthday month.
en..aniv.h: If you’re laid off, you get much less.

zh..x: 雇主每月把你工资的8%存进FGTS账户。你可以改成“生日提款”（saque-aniversário），每年生日那个月提出一部分；但如果被无故解雇，就只能拿40%的罚金，拿不到全部余额。
zh..resc.s: 被解雇时或60岁时，拿到全部余额和罚金。
zh..resc.h: 被裁员时能拿到较多钱。
zh..aniv.h: 被裁员时拿到的少得多。

zht..x: 僱主每月把你薪水的8%存進FGTS帳戶。你可以改成「生日提款」（saque-aniversário），每年生日那個月提出一部分；但如果被無故解僱，就只能拿40%的罰金，拿不到全部餘額。
zht..resc.s: 被解僱時或60歲時，拿到全部餘額和罰金。
zht..resc.h: 被裁員時能拿到較多錢。
zht..aniv.h: 被裁員時拿到的少得多。

events.src: 13º salário: a 13th month's pay by law each December (Lei 4.090/1962).

en..x: By law you get a 13th month’s pay every December.

zh..x: 依法每年十二月你会多领一个月的薪水。

zht..x: 依法每年十二月你會多領一個月的薪水。

events.src: MEI: R$75.90 a month in 2025 (5% of the R$1,518 minimum wage) gives INSS cover and a minimum-wage pension at 65 (62 for women) with 15–20 years of contributions (Metrópoles; Previdenciarista). R$910 a year ≈ 0.045 of the game's typical wage; the pension above what everyone gets (≈ 0.5) is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Registering as an MEI (individual micro-entrepreneur) costs R$75.90 a month in 2025, 5% of the minimum wage, and gives you INSS cover: sick pay, and a minimum-wage pension at 65 (62 for women) after 15–20 years.
en..mei.s: About {a} a year; a pension of about {b} a year from {n}.

zh..x: 登记成微型企业主（MEI）2025年每月R$75.90，是最低工资的5%，可以获得INSS保障：病假津贴，以及缴满15–20年后65岁（女性62岁）起领最低工资的养老金。
zh..mei.s: 每年约{a}；{n}岁起每年领约{b}的养老金。

zht..x: 登記成微型企業主（MEI）2025年每月R$75.90，是最低薪水的5%，可以獲得INSS保障：病假津貼，以及繳滿15–20年後65歲（女性62歲）起領最低薪水的退休金。
zht..mei.s: 每年約{a}；{n}歲起每年領約{b}的退休金。

events.src: Health plans: 52.2 million beneficiaries in January 2025, about 25% of the population; SUS is free for all (ANS, via CQCS; IESS). Premiums and cover are ESTIMATES.

en..x: About 52 million Brazilians, a quarter of the population, have a private health plan. SUS, the public health system, is free for everyone, but waits can be long.
en..plano.s: About {a} a year, rising as you age. Happiness +1.
en..plano.h: It pays about 60% of your medical bills.

zh..x: 约有5,200万巴西人，也就是四分之一的人口，有私人健康保险。公立医疗体系SUS对所有人免费，但可能要等很久。
zh..plano.s: 每年约{a}，年纪越大越贵。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 約有5,200萬巴西人，也就是四分之一的人口，有私人健康保險。公立醫療體系SUS對所有人免費，但可能要等很久。
zht..plano.s: 每年約{a}，年紀越大越貴。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Tesouro Direto: Tesouro IPCA+ 2035 paid about inflation + 6.2% in 2024 (InfoMoney; Money Times); 15% income tax after two years. About 4.5% real after tax and custody fees: an ESTIMATE. Poupança pays roughly inflation: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: With Tesouro Direto you can buy government bonds from about R$30. Tesouro IPCA+ paid inflation plus about 6% a year in 2024, with 15% income tax on the gain after two years; poupança pays much less. You have {a} to put somewhere.
en..ipca.s: Move {a} in. About 4.5% a year after inflation and tax if you hold it to the end.
en..poup.s: Move {a} in. About as much as prices rise.

zh..x: 通过Tesouro Direto约R$30就能买国债。2024年通胀挂钩国债（Tesouro IPCA+）的收益是通胀再加约6%，持有两年以上收益缴15%所得税；储蓄存款（poupança）的收益低得多。你有{a}要找地方放。
zh..ipca.s: 放入{a}。持有到期的话，扣除通胀和税后每年约4.5%。
zh..poup.s: 放入{a}。大约和物价涨幅相同。

zht..x: 透過Tesouro Direto約R$30就能買國債。2024年通膨掛鉤國債（Tesouro IPCA+）的收益是通膨再加約6%，持有兩年以上收益繳15%所得稅；儲蓄存款（poupança）的收益低得多。你有{a}要找地方放。
zht..ipca.s: 放入{a}。持有到期的話，扣除通膨和稅後每年約4.5%。
zht..poup.s: 放入{a}。大約和物價漲幅相同。

events.src: Minha Casa, Minha Vida: Faixa 1 for family incomes up to R$2,850 a month (2024–25; raised in 2026), subsidies up to 95% of the price and interest of about 4–5% (InvestNews; Tenda). Price and subsidy in the game are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .05, fee: .01, r: .005, n: 30, lk: 'trk.br_mcmv', fixed: true })

en..x: Minha Casa, Minha Vida helps lower-income families buy a home: for incomes up to R$2,850 a month (2025), subsidies can cover most of the price and interest is about 4–5% a year. A home in the programme costs {p}.
en..no: Your income is above the programme’s limit.

zh..x: “我的家，我的生活”计划帮助低收入家庭买房：月收入R$2,850以下的家庭（2025年），补贴可以付掉大部分房价，利率约每年4–5%。计划里的一间房子要{p}。
zh..no: 你的收入超过计划的上限。

zht..x: 「我的家，我的生活」計畫幫助低收入家庭買房：月收入R$2,850以下的家庭（2025年），補貼可以付掉大部分房價，利率約每年4–5%。計畫裡的一間房子要{p}。
zht..no: 你的收入超過計畫的上限。

events.src: Floods: in May 2024 floods in Rio Grande do Sul displaced 538,245 people and killed at least 149 (state Civil Defence, via Poder360 and Diário do Nordeste). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: In May 2024 floods in Rio Grande do Sul forced 538,245 people from their homes. Your neighbourhood lies by a river that has flooded before.

zh..x: 2024年5月，南里奥格兰德州的水灾让538,245人被迫离家。你住的社区在一条曾经泛滥的河边。

zht..x: 2024年5月，南里奧格蘭德州的水災讓538,245人被迫離家。你住的社區在一條曾經氾濫的河邊。

events.src: Concursos: the 2024 Concurso Nacional Unificado had about 2.1 million registrations for 6,640 posts, 317 per post (MGI, via O Povo and Gran Cursos). Chances are game rules.

en..x: The 2024 Concurso Nacional Unificado drew about 2.1 million registrations for 6,640 federal posts, about 317 per post. A public job is steady and comes with a pension.

zh..x: 2024年全国统一公职考试约有210万人报名，竞争6,640个联邦职位，约317人争一个。公职工作稳定，还有养老金。

zht..x: 2024年全國統一公職考試約有210萬人報名，競爭6,640個聯邦職位，約317人爭一個。公職工作穩定，還有退休金。

events.src: The ‘new number’ scam: criminals message on WhatsApp pretending to be a relative with a new number and ask for an urgent Pix; in a Mobile Time/Opinion Box survey, 30% of Brazilians with smartphones had been targeted, and 48% of those knew a friend or relative who lost money (via Tecnoblog). Febraban advises checking with the person on their old number first. Banks can try to recover a Pix sent to fraudsters through the Central Bank’s MED, but often can’t. The amount asked (R$3,000 ≈ 0.14) and the chance of getting it back are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: pay(.14 * base); happy -= 3; const t = T('br_pix', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_pix') }); t.v -= .14 * base; if (roll('br_med') < .15) { cash += .14 * base; t.v += .14 * base }

en..t: A message from a new number
en..x: A WhatsApp message from an unknown number, with {n}’s photo: “Hi, it’s me, I changed my number. I have to pay a bill today and my bank app is blocked. Can you send a Pix? I’ll pay you back tomorrow.”
en..send.h: It is almost always a scam, and the bank rarely gets the money back; Happiness −3.
en..call: Call them on the old number first

zh..x: 一个陌生号码在WhatsApp上传来讯息，头像是{n}的照片：“嗨，是我，我换号码了。今天得付一笔账单，可是银行App被锁了，你能先用Pix转给我吗？明天就还你。”
zh..send.h: 这几乎都是诈骗，银行也很少追得回来；幸福感 −3。

zht..x: 一個陌生號碼在WhatsApp上傳來訊息，大頭貼是{n}的照片：「嗨，是我，我換號碼了。今天得付一筆帳單，可是銀行App被鎖了，你能先用Pix轉給我嗎？明天就還你。」
zht..send.h: 這幾乎都是詐騙，銀行也很少追得回來；幸福感 −3。

events.src: Payroll loans for pensioners (consignado INSS): repayments come straight out of the pension, up to 35% of it for loans, at an interest rate capped by the National Social Security Council, below 2% a month in 2025 (INSS). Many pensioners take them out for relatives. The loan size (about R$13,000 ≈ 0.6), the repayments and the odds the relative pays it back are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

lend.do: T('br_consig', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_consig') }); rec('br_consig', y, 5); later(age + 2, 'br_consig', {})

en..x: {p} is behind on the rent and asks you to take out a consignado loan, repaid straight from your pension. The bank says you qualify for {a}.
en..take: Take the full loan for them
en..take.s: About {b} a year comes out of your pension for five years.
en..take.h: Closeness +5; your child may or may not pay you back.
en..half.s: About {b} a year from your pension for five years.
en..no.s: Your pension is all you have.
en.trk.br_consig: A consignado loan for your child
en.log.br_consigOk: Your child has started paying back the consignado loan.
en.log.br_consigNo: Your child can’t help with the consignado payments; they keep coming out of your pension.

zh..x: {p}欠了房租，请你用退休金办一笔挂扣贷款（consignado），直接从退休金里扣还。银行说你可以借到{a}。
zh..take.s: 五年内每年从退休金扣大约{b}。
zh..take.h: 亲近度 +5；孩子不一定会还你。
zh..half.s: 五年内每年从退休金扣大约{b}。
zh.log.br_consigOk: 孩子开始帮你还那笔挂扣贷款了。
zh.log.br_consigNo: 孩子没办法帮忙还贷款，还是一直从你的退休金里扣。

zht..x: {p}欠了房租，請你用退休金辦一筆薪轉扣款貸款（consignado），直接從退休金裡扣還。銀行說你可以借到{a}。
zht..take.s: 五年內每年從退休金扣大約{b}。
zht..take.h: 親近度 +5；孩子不一定會還你。
zht..half.s: 五年內每年從退休金扣大約{b}。
zht.log.br_consigOk: 孩子開始幫你還那筆扣款貸款了。
zht.log.br_consigNo: 孩子沒辦法幫忙還貸款，還是一直從你的退休金裡扣。

events.src: Unauthorised deductions: in April 2025 the Federal Police and the CGU (Operation Sem Desconto) uncovered associations taking monthly fees from pensions without consent; by early 2026 about 4.3 million beneficiaries had been reimbursed R$2.96 billion, and a new law bans such deductions (Congresso em Foco; Monitor Mercantil). Claims go through the Meu INSS app, the 135 line or post offices. The amounts here are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: T('br_desc', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.br_desc') }); rec('br_desc', .01 * base, 5)

en..t: A deduction you never agreed to
en..x: Your neighbour found a monthly fee for an “association” on her pension statement. You check yours: the same fee, for a club you have never heard of.
en..check: Contest it in the Meu INSS app
en..check.h: It takes an afternoon, and the fee stops.
en..ignore: Leave it, it’s only a little
en.trk.br_desc: An association fee you never agreed to

zh..x: 邻居在她的退休金明细上发现一笔每月扣的“协会会费”。你查了自己的：一样的扣款，而且是你从没听过的协会。
zh..check.h: 花一个下午，扣款就停了。
zh.trk.br_desc: 你没同意过的协会会费

zht..x: 鄰居在她的退休金明細上發現一筆每月扣的「協會會費」。你查了自己的：一樣的扣款，而且是你從沒聽過的協會。
zht..check.h: 花一個下午，扣款就停了。
zht.trk.br_desc: 你沒同意過的協會會費

events.src: Consórcios: groups that pool monthly payments, with members drawn each month (or winning a bid, the lance) to receive a credit for a car or a home; there is no interest, only an administration fee, often 15–20% over the term. 12.76 million people were in a consórcio at the end of 2025, a record (ABAC, via sector press). A popular new car (about R$75,000 ≈ 3.5), the fees and the car-loan rate are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: T('br_cons', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.br_cons') }); rec('br_cons', .6 * base, 6)
car = { type: 'new', bal: 3.5 * base, pay: amort(3.5 * base, .15, 5), trk: 'br_loan' }; T('br_loan', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.br_loan') }); happy += 3
spend('br_used', 1.5 * base, 'trk.br_used'); car = { type: 'used', bal: 0, pay: 0, trk: 'br_used' }; happy += 1

en..x: You are tired of crowded buses. The dealer offers a car loan; a colleague has joined a consórcio instead: everyone pays in every month, and each month a draw decides who gets the money for their car.
en..cons.s: About {a} a year for six years; you get the car when you are drawn or win a bid.
en..cons.h: No interest, only the administration fee, but you may wait years.
en..loan: A new car on a loan
en..loan.h: Happiness +3; car-loan interest in Brazil is high.
en..used: A used car, paid in cash
en.trk.br_loan: A new car on a loan

zh..x: 你受够了挤公交。车行可以帮你办车贷；同事则参加了合会购车（consórcio）：大家每月缴钱，每个月抽签决定谁拿到买车的钱。

zht..cons.s: 六年內每年大約{a}；抽中或競標成功時就能拿車。

zht..loan.h: 幸福感 +3；巴西車貸利息很高。

events.src: University: federal universities charge no tuition and fill their places from ENEM scores through Sisu; ProUni gives full scholarships at private universities to students from low-income families (family income up to 1.5 minimum wages a person); FIES lends for private fees (MEC). About 6 in 10 FIES borrowers were behind on repayments in 2024 (Poder360). The scores needed, the share of fees refunded and student-house rents are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

back.do: const c = trk.sk_edu ? trk.sk_edu.cost : 0, x = f * c, y = Math.min(sloan, x); sloan -= y; cash += x - y

en..x: Your ENEM results are out. A federal university in another city is free but takes only the top scores; private universities near home charge monthly fees, with a FIES loan to pay them, or a ProUni scholarship for families on low incomes.
en..fed: A federal university in another city
en..fed.s: No tuition; about {a} to share a house with other students.
en..fed.h: Most of your fees are refunded; Relationships −2 from moving away.
en..score: Your ENEM score isn’t high enough.
en..prouni: A ProUni scholarship at a private university
en..fies: A private university with a FIES loan
en..fies.s: Close to home; the loan is repaid once you work.

zht..fed.s: 免學費；和其他學生合租房子大約{a}。

events.src: Desenrola Fies: borrowers behind on their payments could settle FIES debts with discounts of up to 77%, or 99% for families on the CadÚnico register (MEC, 2023–24); a new round is open until 31 December 2026 (Novo Desenrola Brasil). The share of the debt paid here is an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A bad year left you behind on your FIES repayments, and the debt has grown to {a}. The government’s Desenrola programme offers to settle it at a big discount.
en..settle.s: Pay about {a} and the rest is forgiven.

zh..x: 有一年手头紧，你的FIES学贷没还上，欠款涨到了{a}。政府的Desenrola方案说可以大幅打折让你结清。

zht..x: 有一年手頭緊，你的FIES學貸沒還上，欠款漲到了{a}。政府的Desenrola方案說可以大幅打折讓你結清。

events.src: Private pensions: banks sell PGBL and VGBL plans, often with administration fees of 1.5–2.5% a year (Susep; consumer guides); Tesouro IPCA+ bonds pay a fixed rate above inflation, around 7% in 2025, taxed on the gain (Tesouro Nacional). The fee used and the returns after inflation and tax are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your bank manager calls: with {a} sitting in your account, you should open a VGBL private pension plan, which “beats the poupança”. A friend says to buy Tesouro IPCA+ bonds yourself instead.
en..vgbl.s: Move {a} in; the bank manages it.
en..vgbl.h: Invested like a fund, minus about 2% a year in fees.
en..tes.s: Move {a} in, through the government’s site.
en..tes.h: A fixed rate above inflation, about 4.5% a year after tax, if you hold to maturity.

zh..t: 银行经理推荐的退休计划
zh..x: 银行经理打电话来说，你账户里放着{a}，应该开一个VGBL私人退休计划，“比储蓄账户强多了”。朋友却劝你自己去买Tesouro IPCA+公债。
zh..vgbl.h: 像基金一样投资，但每年扣大约2%的管理费。
zh..tes.h: 固定的通胀以上利率，持有到期的话税后每年约4.5%。

zht..t: 銀行經理推薦的退休計畫
zht..x: 銀行經理打電話來說，你帳戶裡放著{a}，應該開一個VGBL私人退休計畫，「比儲蓄帳戶強多了」。朋友卻勸你自己去買Tesouro IPCA+公債。
zht..vgbl.h: 像基金一樣投資，但每年扣大約2%的管理費。
zht..tes.h: 固定的通膨以上利率，持有到期的話稅後每年約4.5%。

events.src: Brazilians in Portugal: 493,622 Brazilian residents at the end of 2025, the largest foreign community and 31% of all foreign residents (AIMA, Migration and Asylum Report 2025, via DN Brasil). Portugal’s minimum wage is €920 a month in 2026, paid 14 times a year (via Postal). Pay abroad, living costs, fees and the length of the stay are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

en..x: A cousin in Lisbon says the restaurant where she works needs people and can help with the papers. Pay there would be about {a} a year, but rents in Lisbon are steep.

zh..x: 住在里斯本的表姐说，她工作的餐厅缺人，还能帮忙办证件。那边年薪大约{a}，不过里斯本房租很贵。

zht..x: 住在里斯本的表姊說，她工作的餐廳缺人，還能幫忙辦證件。那邊年薪大約{a}，不過里斯本房租很貴。

events.src: The laje: building an extra floor on top of a relative’s house is common in Brazilian cities; since Law 13,465/2017 the ‘direito de laje’ lets such a floor be registered as a property of its own (Civil Code, articles 1,510-A to 1,510-E). Building costs, rents and the risk of a tenant not paying are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: spend('br_laje', 1.2 * base, 'trk.br_laje'); T('br_lajer', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_lajer') }); rec('br_lajer', -.2 * base, 30); happy -= 1
spend('br_laje', 1.2 * base, 'trk.br_laje'); T('br_lajei', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_lajei') }); rec('br_lajei', -.15 * base, 30)

en..x: The family house has a flat concrete roof, a laje, and your uncle the builder says he could put a two-room floor on top. You could live there yourself, or rent it out.
en..live.h: No more rent; Relationships +3 living near family, but little privacy, Happiness −1.
en..rent: Build it and rent it out
en..rent.h: Rent comes in every month, if the tenant pays.
en..no: Leave the roof as it is
en.trk.br_lajer: Rent saved living on the laje

zh..x: 家里的房子是平顶水泥屋顶（laje），当营造工人的叔叔说可以在上面加盖一层两房的。你可以自己住，也可以租出去。
zh..live.h: 不用再付房租；住在家人旁边，人际关系 +3，但没什么隐私，幸福感 −1。
zh..rent.h: 每个月有房租收入，前提是房客肯付。

zht..x: 家裡的房子是平頂水泥屋頂（laje），當營造工人的叔叔說可以在上面加蓋一層兩房的。你可以自己住，也可以租出去。
zht..live.h: 不用再付房租；住在家人旁邊，人際關係 +3，但沒什麼隱私，幸福感 −1。
zht..rent.h: 每個月有房租收入，前提是房客肯付。

events.src: Evictions for unpaid rent go through the courts under the Tenancy Law (Lei 8.245/1991) and can take months. Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

lost.do: pay(x); const t = T('br_lajei', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_lajei') }); t.v -= x

en..x: Your tenant upstairs hasn’t paid for four months. He says he lost his job and will pay when he can.
en..court: Go to court to evict him
en..court.h: Happiness −2; a new tenant within a few months.
en..wait.h: Most of the missing rent is never paid; Happiness −1.

zh..x: 楼上的房客已经四个月没付房租了。他说他丢了工作，等有钱再付。
zh..court.h: 幸福感 −2；几个月内换新房客。
zh..wait.h: 欠的房租大多要不回来；幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 樓上的房客已經四個月沒付房租了。他說他丟了工作，等有錢再付。
zht..court.h: 幸福感 −2；幾個月內換新房客。
zht..wait.h: 欠的房租大多要不回來；幸福感 −1。

events.src: App work: about 1.5 million people in Brazil worked through apps in 2022, most of them driving passengers or delivering (IBGE, PNAD Contínua, 2023). Drivers without a car rent one by the week. Earnings after car rental and fuel, and the hours, are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: T('br_app', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.br_app') }); rec('br_app', -.35 * base, 1, -1); happy -= 1

en..x: Since the layoff, your savings are draining. A friend rents a car by the week and drives for the apps; he says you could clear more than the minimum wage.
en..drive: Rent a car and drive for the apps
en..drive.s: Long days; the car rental and fuel come out of what you make.
en..drive.h: Extra income for a year; Health −1, Happiness −1.
en..look.s: Keep your days for applications and interviews.

zh..x: 被裁员之后，存款一直在减少。一个朋友按周租车跑网约车，他说你一个月赚的可以比最低工资还多。
zh..drive.s: 工时很长；租车费和油钱都从收入里扣。
zh..drive.h: 一年的额外收入；健康 −1，幸福感 −1。
zh..look.s: 把时间留给投履历和面试。

zht..x: 被裁員之後，存款一直在減少。一個朋友按週租車跑叫車平台，他說你一個月賺的可以比最低工資還多。
zht..drive.s: 工時很長；租車費和油錢都從收入裡扣。
zht..drive.h: 一年的額外收入；健康 −1，幸福感 −1。
zht..look.s: 把時間留給投履歷和面試。

events.src: Car theft: hundreds of thousands of vehicles are stolen or taken in robberies in Brazil every year (Fórum Brasileiro de Segurança Pública, Anuário 2024). Insurance premiums (often 4–6% of the car’s value a year in big cities), the cost of a GPS tracker and the chance of a theft are an ESTIMATE. Amounts are compared with the game’s typical wage in Brazil, about R$21,700 a year (9,000 PPP dollars × 2.41).

opts.do: br_seg = 2; T('br_seg', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.br_seg') }); rec('br_seg', .15 * base, 5); later(age + 2, 'br_roubo', {})
br_seg = 1; T('br_trk', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.br_trk') }); rec('br_trk', .03 * base, 5); later(age + 2, 'br_roubo', {})

later.br_roubo: if (car && roll('br_roubo') < (br_seg === 1 ? .08 : .15)) { if (br_seg === 2) { happy -= 2; log(M('log.br_rouboIns'), 'bad') } else { car = null; happy -= 6; log(M('log.br_roubo'), 'bad') } }

en..x: Two cars were stolen on your street last month. The insurance quote is high in your neighbourhood; a GPS tracker is cheaper and helps the police find stolen cars.
en..ins.h: If the car is stolen, the insurer replaces it.
en..track.h: Stolen cars with trackers are often found.
en..none.h: If it is stolen, it is gone.
en.log.br_rouboIns: Your car was stolen. The insurer paid for a replacement, after weeks of paperwork.
en.log.br_roubo: Your car was stolen and never found.

zh..x: 上个月你家那条街被偷了两辆车。你住的地区车险报价很高；装GPS追踪器比较便宜，也能帮警察找回被偷的车。
zh..ins.h: 车被偷的话，保险公司赔一辆。
zh..track.h: 装了追踪器的车被偷后常常找得回来。
zh.log.br_rouboIns: 你的车被偷了。办了几个星期的手续后，保险公司赔了一辆。
zh.log.br_roubo: 你的车被偷了，一直没找到。

zht..x: 上個月你家那條街被偷了兩輛車。你住的地區車險報價很高；裝GPS追蹤器比較便宜，也能幫警察找回被偷的車。
zht..ins.h: 車被偷的話，保險公司賠一輛。
zht..track.h: 裝了追蹤器的車被偷後常常找得回來。
zht.log.br_rouboIns: 你的車被偷了。辦了幾個星期的手續後，保險公司賠了一輛。
zht.log.br_roubo: 你的車被偷了，一直沒找到。
